newsitem.title: USA: Metzler to acquire Resource Management.
newsitem.headline: Metzler to acquire Resource Management.

text.p: Metzler Group Inc, which provides consulting services to electric and gas utilities and other energy-related businesses, said Monday it signed a letter of intent to buy Resource Management Inc.
Privately held Resource Management had 1996 revenues of about $35 million.
Metzler Group said, excluding merger costs, it expects the transaction to add to earnings per share in 1997 and thereafter.
The transaction will be accounted for as a pooling of interests.

Under the deal, which is subject to Resource Management shareholder approval and the completion of due diligence, Resource Management shareholders will receive about 2.6 million shares of Metzler common stock.

The transaction is expected to be completed within 90 days. After that, Resource Management will operate as an independent, wholly owned subsidiary of Metzler, with Lloyd Harvego, president and founder of Resource Management, as president of the unit.

Resource Management is a strategic management, resource management and engineering consulting company serving electric, gas and water utilities, as well as the telecommunications industry and governmental entities.

"This transaction represents a significant step in our ongoing plans to grow the company through business combinations and execute our strategy of consolidating consulting services to the energy industry," Robert Maher, Metzler chairman, said in a statement.

He said Resource Management's strength among clients based mainly in the western and eastern United States, together with its overseas presence, will complement Metzler's historic concentration of Midwest clients.
